posts.title: Fifty
posts.description: 2026 is the year I turn fifty. To commemorate this beautiful milestone, I created a 50-minute ambient/drone track. I’ve wanted to create an ambient soundscape longer than 5 minutes for quite a while now, but I never had the inspiration or, more truthfully, the patience to work on such a long track. I got the idea for this one after reaching another personal milestone: fifty OneChord Shorts uploade

posts.title: Try This Progression
posts.description: Since creating OneChord , one thing that never really sat right with me was the Next Chord button. I’d used a massive dataset ( Chordonomicon - 666,000 chord progressions) to look for the most frequent follow-up chord. The result, however, was that all chords eventually led back to C or G , at which point you were playing chord tennis. It didn’t offer much beyond what the OneChord logo already off
